title: Moving the cursor over a scroll bar in the editor sometimes scrolls (without mouse click)
body:
### Tested versions

I have produced this behaviour in Godot 4.7.2 stable and 4.7.1 stable. I do not recall it happening in 4.7.0.

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 21 Aug 2026 22:18:59 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 610.57.04) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 62.01 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In the editor, moving the mouse cursor over any scroll bar tends to immediately scroll as if you had clicked on the scroll bar. This is obviously super annoying since it makes you lose your place in the code.

### Steps to reproduce

I can most reliably reproduce this in the file system browser. It seems to care whether the UI element is focused in some sense, since it only happens after you click on a file at least once.

The trouble is, this only starts happening after Godot has been open a while (usually after more than an hour). My system shows plenty of free memory at that point, so I do not know what exactly triggers it. Restarting Godot fixes it for a while.

This also applies to the code map, which has led to me disabling the map entirely since it is easy to accidentally move your mouse over it and immediately jump to a random place in the file.

I am happy to provide more information if someone has an idea what information could be helpful. I do not have this issue in any non-Godot applications, and I have tested it with different mice and a trackpad, so the hardware is not at fault.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This happens on any project for me. It just has to be big enough to have scroll bars present.
